selection.ownership: Gecko Labs Pte. Ltd. (UEN 201510008G), Singapore. The reviewed edition is the international CoinGecko Pro API at pro-api.coingecko.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official CoinGecko Pro API authentication (x-cg-pro-api-key header to https://pro-api.coingecko.com/api/v3), currencies/coin/global/trending reads, Gecko Labs Pte. Ltd. Singapore identity, and dated incident search for CoinGecko security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. The June 2024 GetResponse third-party email-platform contact export and January 2024 X-account compromise are recorded as historical non-China events. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

breach.coverage: On 2024-06-05 CoinGecko reported that an attacker exported nearly 2 million contacts from its GetResponse email-marketing account after compromising a GetResponse employee account, then sent phishing mail from another GetResponse client. CoinGecko stated user accounts and passwords remained secure. The January 2024 X-account compromise posted a fraudulent airdrop after a malicious Calendly link; both X accounts were later secured. No unresolved CoinGecko Pro API platform compromise was identified in this 2026-09-13 review.

exception.authority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 for historical non-China incidents
exception.incident: June 2024 GetResponse third-party email-platform contact export (~2 million contacts) and January 2024 CoinGecko/GeckoTerminal X-account compromise
exception.remediation: GetResponse incident: CoinGecko investigated with the vendor, notified affected users, and reviewed vendor security procedures. X-account incident: unauthorized app access revoked and both accounts secured after a malicious Calendly link.
exception.residualRisk: Historical third-party marketing-contact exposure and social-account takeover; live authentication unverified. Demo API keys against api.coingecko.com are a separate host and are not accepted by this Pro edition.
exception.adoption: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 explicitly permits historical non-China incident adoption for these CoinGecko Pro API read operations.
exception.usefulness: Currency, coin, global-market, and trending reads provide useful market data while preserving provider JSON contracts.

research.searchCoverage: Official CoinGecko Pro API v3 at https://pro-api.coingecko.com/api/v3 with recommended x-cg-pro-api-key header, GET /simple/supported_vs_currencies, GET /coins/{id}, GET /global, and GET /search/trending were confirmed on 2026-09-13. Operator is Gecko Labs Pte. Ltd., Singapore (UEN 201510008G). Demo API at api.coingecko.com with x-cg-demo-api-key is a separate edition and is not exposed. Website scraping is not used. Historical GetResponse and X-account incidents are recorded. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

incidents.finding: Attacker exported nearly 2 million contacts from CoinGecko's GetResponse account after compromising a GetResponse employee account and sent 23,723 phishing emails from another GetResponse client. CoinGecko said user accounts and passwords remained secure; leaked data included names, emails, IP addresses, and email-open locations.
incidents.remediation: CoinGecko investigated with GetResponse, informed affected users, and reviewed vendor security procedures.
incidents.limitation: Historical third-party marketing-platform incident; no unresolved Pro API compromise identified in this 2026-09-13 review.

incidents.finding: CoinGecko and GeckoTerminal X accounts posted a fraudulent token airdrop after a team member clicked a malicious Calendly link that granted unauthorized app access despite 2FA.
incidents.remediation: Unauthorized access revoked; both X accounts secured.
incidents.limitation: Social-account compromise, not a CoinGecko API platform breach.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
